🌟 scottokeebs | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing open-source designs and resources for hobbyists to build their own custom handwired mechanical keyboards and macropads.
✨ Key Features: • Free-to-build handwired keyboard and macropad projects • Over 19 released projects • Projects designed for common 220x220mm 3D printers • Minimal support material required for 3D prints
📖 Summary: This repository offers a comprehensive collection of free, open-source designs for building custom handwired mechanical keyboards and macropads. It provides detailed project files and guidance, enabling users to create their own unique input devices using common microcontrollers like Arduino Pro Micro or Raspberry Pi Pico.
